performance.verdict: Intentional throttle masks real problem: 7 leads in 28 days is unsustainable.

findings.text: CPL hit $238.33 over 28 days on only 7 GHL-tracked leads — series shows 10 leads-zero days in last 14, confirming chronic drought, not a blip.
6 overdue SOW milestones (earliest: 2026-07-31 booking bot battle-test): intake owner unconfirmed, LSA heating toggle, Review Boost, Financing page, Homer Glen branch all undelivered.
3-day signal (Sep 12–14): spend $107.46 total, 1 lead — vs prior 3 days (Sep 9–11): spend $156.21, 0 leads. Google spend collapsed to avg $16.72/day, down from $67.36/day 7d prior.
GBP divergence: 'Quality HVAC Solutions' drives 27 of 29 total calls (2.44% call rate, 1,105 impressions) while the two Fibid profiles produce only 2 calls combined across 343 impressions.
GHL pipeline shows 834 opportunities created vs 47 won and 0 appointments logged — with the intake owner seat vacant since 7/7, leads arriving are likely going unworked.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login immediately — 834 opps created, 0 appointments logged signals an empty seat eating leads.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and no replacement has been confirmed; GHL shows 0 appointments against 834 created opportunities, meaning speed-to-lead automations are firing into a vacant seat. Nacer to confirm who owns intake now, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is in place. Success check: a named owner with confirmed GHL access logged by 2026-09-18. Until this is resolved, the SOW gate explicitly blocks any budget scale-up.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 6 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; LSA heating toggle (due 2026-09-01) is the highest-urgency revenue gate entering heating season.
suggestions.monday_update: Six milestones are past due, the oldest since 2026-07-31 (booking bot battle-test). The LSA heating toggle was due 2026-09-01 — heating season is now live and LSA is off, directly costing calls. Sohib to present the full overdue list to Nacer and get hard delivery dates for each item, prioritising LSA re-enable and intake owner confirmation. Success check: all 6 items have an assigned owner and a delivery date confirmed in writing by 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Watch Google spend recovery: daily avg dropped to $16.72 over last 3 days — do not scale until intake owner confirmed per SOW gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Google spend collapsed to an average of $16.72/day over Sep 12–14, down from a 7-day prior average of ~$67/day — contributing directly to the 50% lead drop. The SOW explicitly blocks raising budgets until the intake owner is confirmed and the scale-back-up gate is cleared. Re-check on 2026-09-18: if intake owner is confirmed and Google daily spend remains below $25, escalate to Sohib for a controlled step-up discussion.
